subject: Science
overview: Indha chapter-la night sky stars, constellations, Pole Star, planets, Moon, comets, Solar System matrum Milky Way Galaxy pathi padippom. Textbook-la irukkura ideas-ai use panni, ivatrai sky-la eppadi identify pannalaam-nu purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Stars thangaloda own light-ai produce pannum; constellation-na enna-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Big Dipper, Little Dipper matrum Pole Star direction kandupidikka eppadi help pannum-nu solla mudiyum.
Adults-oda safe-aa night sky observe panni Big Dipper matrum Pole Star-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Sun-um oru star dhaan; Earth-oda rotation matrum revolution-ai distinguish panna mudiyum.
Stars, planets, natural satellites-ai compare panni telescope-oda use-ai explain panna mudiyum.
Solar System objects, comets, asteroids, Milky Way Galaxy matrum Universe pathi describe panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Night sky-la stars and patterns
teaching_sequence.caption: Ladakh-oda Nubra region-la Yangdol-um Dorjay-um clear night sky-la neraya stars-ai paarkkiraanga. Stars thangaloda own light-ai emit pannum. Sila stars bright-aa, sila dim-aa theriyum. Sila stars-ai imaginary lines-la connect pannina familiar shapes maadhiri theriyum; indha patterns-ai constellations-nu azhaippom. Pazhaya kaalathula travellers direction kandupidikka stars-ai use panninaanga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Night sky-la neraya stars theriyum. Sila stars-ai imaginary lines-la connect pannina oru shape kidaikkum. Andha pattern dhaan constellation. Idhai innum konjam explore pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Stars thangaloda own light-ai produce pannuma? Constellation-na enna? Pazhaya travellers-ku stars eppadi help pannuchu?

teaching_sequence.title: Constellations and the Pole Star
teaching_sequence.caption: International Astronomical Union sky-ai 88 official regions-aa divide pannirukku; indha regions constellations-nu azhaikkappadum. Orion, Big Dipper matrum Little Dipper examples. Little Dipper-la irukkura Polaris, adhaavadhu Pole Star, north direction pakkathula almost same position-la theriyum. Adhanaala Northern Hemisphere-la north direction kandupidikka adhu useful.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Constellations-ku different patterns-um names-um irukku. Aana north direction kandupidikka endha star help pannum? Pole Star-oda role-ai paapom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Pole Star endha direction-ai kaatta help pannum? Big Dipper-um Little Dipper-um edharku useful?

teaching_sequence.title: Safe-aa night sky observe pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Night sky paarkka adults-oda mattum safe-aana open place-ku poganum. Street lights, tall buildings, trees kammiya irukkura idathai choose pannu. Clear night helpful. Sky map app alladhu star chart use pannalaam; dark-ku eyes adjust aaga sumaar 30 minutes wait pannina stars better-aa theriyum. Dark place-ku thaniya pogakoodadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Night sky observation exciting-aa irukkum; aana safety first. Adult kooda safe place choose panni, eyes dark-ku adjust aaga konjam wait pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Night sky paarkka place eppadi choose pannanum? Dark-ku eyes adjust aaga yen wait pannanum? Yaar kooda poganum?

teaching_sequence.title: Sun, stars and Earth-oda movement
teaching_sequence.caption: Sun-um oru star dhaan. Adhu Earth-kku romba pakkathula irukkaradhunaala perusaavum bright-aa theriyudhu; matra stars dhoorathula irukkaradhunaala small dots maadhiri theriyum. Pagal-la Sun-oda brightness nala matra stars namakku theriyadhu. Earth than axis-ai sutri rotate aaguradhukku sumaar 24 hours aagum; Sun-ai sutri oru revolution mudikka sumaar oru year aagum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Sun-um oru star dhaan; namakku pakkathula irukkaradhunaala perusa theriyudhu. Ippo Earth-oda rotation-um revolution-um eppadi different-nu paapom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Sun perusa theriyuradhukku main reason enna? Earth-oda rotation-ku evlo neram aagum? Revolution-na enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Planets, Moon and telescopes
teaching_sequence.caption: Planets-um stars maadhiri bright dots-aa theriyalaam; aana planets usually twinkle kammiya irukkum. Venus-ai sunrise-kku mun Eastern sky-layum sunset-kku pin Western sky-layum paarkka mudiyum. Telescope dim objects-ai brighter-aa, larger-aa paarkka help pannum. Planets-ai sutri move aagura objects satellites; Moon Earth-oda natural satellite.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Sky-la theriyura bright object star-aa planet-aa-nu observe pannalaam. Venus dawn alladhu dusk-la theriyalaam. Telescope namakku dim objects-ai clearer-aa paarkka help pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Stars-um planets-um twinkling-la eppadi different? Telescope enna help pannum? Earth-oda natural satellite edhu?

teaching_sequence.title: Solar System and Milky Way
teaching_sequence.caption: Solar System-la Sun, eight planets, avatrin moons, asteroids matrum comets irukkindrana. Sun dhaan Solar System-la largest and heaviest object. Comets-la ice-um rocky material-um irukkum; Sun-kku pakkathula varumbodhu tail develop aagalaam. Dark sky-la theriyura faint light band namma Milky Way Galaxy; namma Solar System adhan oru pagudhi.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Sun, planets, moons, asteroids, comets ellam serndhadhu Solar System. Namma Solar System-um Milky Way Galaxy-oda oru small part dhaan.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Solar System-la enna objects irukkum? Comet Sun-kku pakkathula varumbodhu enna nadakkalaam? Namma Solar System endha galaxy-la irukku?

teaching_sequence.title: Review and observe what you learnt
teaching_sequence.caption: Indha stage-la planet names and order, Big Dipper, Little Dipper, Pole Star, Orion matrum Sirius-ai identify pannuvom. Daytime-la Sunlight-oda brightness nala stars theriyadhu. Big Dipper move aagura maadhiri theriyalaam; Pole Star north pakkathula almost fixed-aa theriyum. Adult guidance-oda sky observation-ai repeat panni record pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo namma learning-ai check pannuvom. Planet order, constellation patterns, Pole Star direction-ai textbook figure-oda compare panni paaru.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Daytime-la stars yen theriyadhu? Pole Star-oda position eppadi theriyum? Big Dipper-ai eppadi identify pannalaam?

teaching_sequence.title: Keep asking why
teaching_sequence.caption: Science-la pala periya discoveries simple-aana 'Why?' kelviyilirundhu start aagum. Night sky-la paarkkura ovvoru object-um pudhu kelvi kekka inspire pannalaam. Observe pannu, kelvi kelu, evidence thedu, un explanation-ai test pannu — idhudhaan scientific curiosity-oda journey.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Indha chapter-la stars-lirundhu galaxies varaikkum explore pannom. Inime sky-la edha paathaalum 'Idhu enna? Yen ippadi theriyudhu?' nu kelvi kelu; science journey continue aagattum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Indha chapter-la unakku pudhusa therinjadhu enna? Night sky pathi nee kekka virumbura oru scientific question enna?
